title: Off the Seventh Rank
setup: Queen and bishop already aim at g7, and only the queen on d7 defends it along the rank.
hint: Count the attackers and the defenders of g7, then find the check that reduces the defenders by one.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxe8+}} is check, and {{Qxe8}} is Black's only reply — which takes the queen off the seventh rank. {{Qxg7#}} follows, held in place by the bishop on b2. The rook is spent to leave one attacker more than there are defenders.
